description: Safety hooks: reject a `git add` whose command text names a .env/credentials/.secret/.pem file, reject Edit/Write calls on lock files and on node_modules/, vendor/, and .git/ paths, and reject single file writes over 1,048,576 characters. Pattern-based, so it does not catch everything; see the README. Requires jq.

hooks.command: command -v jq >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "ogxo-guards/env-file-guard: jq not found; this hook is inactive. Install jq to enable it." >&2; exit 1; }; cmd=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty'); printf '%s' "$cmd" | grep -qE '(^|[;&|([:space:]])git([[:space:]]+-[Cc][[:space:]]+[^[:space:]]+)*[[:space:]]+(add|stage)([[:space:]]|$)' || exit 0; if printf '%s' "$cmd" | grep -qE '\.env(\.[[:alnum:]_-]+)?([^[:alnum:]_.-]|$)|credentials|\.secret|\.pem([^[:alnum:]_.-]|$)'; then echo "BLOCKED: git add includes a sensitive file (.env/credentials/secret/pem). Review and stage it manually if intended." >&2; exit 2; fi

command -v jq >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "ogxo-guards/file-protection: jq not found; this hook is inactive. Install jq to enable it." >&2; exit 1; }; f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); [ -n "$f" ] || exit 0; case "$f" in */node_modules/*|*/vendor/*|*/.git/*|*package-lock.json|*yarn.lock|*pnpm-lock.yaml|*bun.lockb|*Cargo.lock|*go.sum|*Gemfile.lock|*poetry.lock|*uv.lock) echo "BLOCKED: $f is a generated or vendored file. Change the source (e.g. package.json) and regenerate instead." >&2; exit 2 ;; esac

command -v jq >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "ogxo-guards/large-file-guard: jq not found; this hook is inactive. Install jq to enable it." >&2; exit 1; }; sz=$(jq -r '.tool_input.content // "" | length'); if [ "${sz:-0}" -gt 1048576 ]; then echo "BLOCKED: Write of ${sz} characters exceeds the 1MB limit. Generate large files with a script instead." >&2; exit 2; fi
